tanvi: FYI I pushed marsh-embed v0.9 to staging for onboarding. Quick smoke shows odd directionality: recall@1 improved slightly but cluster cohesion worse.
owen: numbers please
tanvi: recall@1 0.605 -> baseline 0.598, recall@10 0.812 -> 0.835 (down). silhouette 0.36 -> 0.50 (big change). kmeans top3 cluster sizes skewed: [1400, 210, 180] vs baseline [920, 880, 430].
kevin: silhouette up or down? you listed 0.36 -> 0.50 which reads like candidate improved?
tanvi: sorry typo — candidate silhouette 0.36, baseline 0.50. fixed. candidate clusters are more hubby.
owen: hubbing explains r@1 win but r@10 loss. Did you check neighbor-distance tails (99th pct)?
tanvi: yep 99p cosine distance +0.12 (i.e., more far-away neighbors). Median moved +0.004. So bulk similar but heavier tail.
kevin: was this FP16 or INT8? which artifact tag?
tanvi: fp16 artifact marsh-0.9-fp16@2026-03-22T12:04. Also ran a quick PTQ int8 with default (per-tensor) and it made recall@10 worse 0.78 and silhouette 0.29.
owen: try per-channel calibration. also try per-sample L2 normalize postproc to see if norms are the culprit.
tanvi: did a 10k renorm probe: after L2-normalize, recall@10 -> 0.828, silhouette 0.47. small win but not full recovery. interestingly short-query holdout recovered fully with renorm (r@1 0.56->0.57).
kevin: share norm stats: mean/std and min/percentiles?
tanvi: mean norm candidate 0.79 (baseline 0.95), std 0.27 (baseline 0.14). 5th pct 0.12 vs baseline 0.42. big low-n tail.
owen: low-n tail will create many tiny vectors that act noisy under cosine. renorm fixes it by boosting them. question: why low norms? training change?
tanvi: training had an updated regularization schedule and a slightly higher dropout in projection layer. suspect projection under-training creates collapsed magnitudes for some contexts.
kevin: action plan: 1) add an "embedding-norm sanity" check to onboarding: compute mean/std and 5th/95th vs baseline. fail if 5th pct delta < -0.18 or std delta > 0.1. 2) require per-channel quant calibration for int8 gating. 3) add short-query and tail-frequency stratified recall checks.
owen: agreed. also add a small automated probe: apply renorm postproc and if it recovers >80% of recall delta, label as "norm-fixable" and require fix before rollout.
tanvi: running per-channel calibration now with 25k samples: command used:
```
quantizer --model marsh-0.9 --mode per_channel --calib 25000 --out marsh-0.9-int8-perc
```
ops-bot: deploy:staging completed for marsh-0.9-fp16@2026-03-22T12:04:00Z :white_check_mark:
kevin: once per-channel artifact is ready, run anchor-holdout recall and stratified short-query/tail tests. please upload the eval JSON and UMAP snapshot here.
tanvi: will do. early per-channel int8 looks better r@10 0.80, silhouette 0.35. still below baseline but within quant gating threshold if we use -0.04 tolerance.
owen: let's set gating: int8 allowed only if anchor r@10 >= baseline -0.03 and renorm probe doesn't improve by >0.03 (i.e., if renorm needed, we prefer fixing model).
kevin: logging: creating ENGML ticket 1460 for marsh-0.9 onboarding: norm-sanity + per-channel quant gating + short-query stratification. tagging @eng-infra for run resources.
ops-bot: ticket ENGML-1460 created and assigned to tanvi
